PackageConfiguration.Author: TIA MCP
PackageConfiguration.Description: Sends the exact selected project-tree objects to a locally enrolled TIA MCP Host for review. Reads only; makes no engineering changes.

System.Security.Permissions.EnvironmentP.Comment: Reads TIAMCP_ARTIFACTS and the computer name.

System.Security.Permissions.FileIOPermis.Comment: Reads the Host discovery file and saved project reviews; writes nothing.

System.Security.Permissions.SecurityPerm.Comment: Opens the local Host pipe and verifies its server process (kernel32 pipe calls, GetNamedPipeServerProcessId, GetProcessTimes).
